summary.description: Two to five sentences: the overall picture, including patterns across tests and differences between JDK versions.

testId.description: The id from failures.json (T1, T2, ...), or JDK<N> for a JDK version without E2E results.

explanation.description: The root cause and the reasoning that leads to the verdict.

jdkDifference.description: Whether the outcome differs between JDK versions and what that tells about the cause.

location.description: A repository path with line number (path:line), or an artifact path.

detail.description: What this location shows, quoted where possible.

suggestedFix.description: The change that would fix the root cause. Described only, never applied.
